doc_friction.issue: The audit-skip list does not mention that colour contrast is already covered (contrast.mjs, PRs #14667/#15542/#16002); I only found that by searching PR titles. Its 'conformance-test against a reference implementation' pattern, used by several explore runs, is not named either and would be a useful pointer.

notes: Explore idea: differential-test codeowners-shadow-check's gitignore-style matcher against git check-ignore. Found ~1% of generated pairs wrong, one bug: trailing ** (docs/**, implied by build/) matched zero segments, so build/ owned a file scripts/build and produced a false shadow. Fixed with a one-or-more '**+' marker; 7 seeds x ~45k compared pairs then agree. Also added a redundant-rule notice (shadowed only by same-owner rules) after running the tool on this repo's own CODEOWNERS, which has two (/CLAUDE.md, /AGENTS.md). Committed test: 3 seeds, ~20k pairs, <2 s, 102 disagreements on the old code. Verified: run_venture_tests.py codeowners-shadow-check ok; Playwright smoke test of index.html; check_posts.py ok. CI's changed-ventures job was red from main: #17715 put a literal U+FEFF in shift-roster-builder/import-deputy-staff.mjs's BOM-stripping regex, failing check_hidden_unicode.py; rewrote it as \uFEFF (same behaviour, 19 deputy tests pass).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: write a git differential fuzz harness, diagnose and fix the matcher, add a feature, docs and post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
